title_sq: Shitet apartament 1+1 ne nje nga rezidencat me te reja te zones!
description_sq:
Shitet apartament 1+1 ne nje nga rezidencat me te reja te zones!
Apartamenti me siperfaqe totale 75 m2 organizohet ne sallon- kuzhine, dhome gjumi, tualet dhe ballkon me dalje nga sallon.
Kjo mundesi eshte zgjedhja ideale si per banim, ashtu dhe per investim afatgjate, fale lokacionit strategjik me akses te shpejte ne zonat me te kerkuara te qytetit.
Per me shume informacion ose nje vizite ne prone na kontaktoni.
title_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in one of the newest residences in the area!
description_en: 1+1 apartment for sale in one of the newest residences in the area! The apartment with a total area of ​​75 m2 is organized in living room-kitchen, bedroom, bathroom and balcony with exit from the living room. This opportunity is the ideal choice for both residence and long-term investment, thanks to the strategic location with quick access to the most sought-after areas of the city. For more information or a visit to the property, contact us.
